blocks.en: Section 1: Light Transmission & Moisture Permeation Tests

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 掌握乾燥劑法三個子方法（Method 1、2、3）的具體操作程序和各自適用的容器類型
blocks.en: Master the specific procedures of the three desiccant sub-methods (Methods 1, 2 and 3) and the container types each applies to

blocks.zh: 理解旋蓋扭矩（torque）規格在 Method 1 測試中的重要性及查表方式（Table 2）
blocks.en: Understand the importance of closure torque specifications in Method 1 testing and how to look them up (Table 2)

blocks.zh: 掌握線性回歸分析在 MVTR 計算中的應用，理解斜率（slope）即為 MVTR
blocks.en: Master the application of linear regression analysis in MVTR calculation, and understand that the slope is the MVTR

blocks.zh: 理解水法（Method 4）的程序邏輯，包括用水量計算和反向條件設計
blocks.en: Understand the procedural logic of the water method (Method 4), including the water quantity calculation and the reverse-condition design

blocks.zh: 掌握分類系統（Methods 5–8）的操作程序和分類判定標準（tight、well-closed、Class A–D）
blocks.en: Master the procedures of the classification system (Methods 5–8) and the classification criteria (tight, well-closed, Class A–D)

blocks.zh: Desiccant Methods — Desiccant Preparation & Procedures 乾燥劑準備與操作程序
blocks.en: Desiccant Methods — Desiccant Preparation & Procedures

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 乾燥劑選擇邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Logic of Desiccant Selection

blocks.zh: Method 1 (氯化鈣，CaCl₂)：用於多單元容器（瓶裝）。氯化鈣是強力乾燥劑，吸濕量大，適合需要測試 14–35 天的長時間實驗。但必須先在 215°C 乾燥 7.25 小時，確保六水合物完全轉化為無水物——因為六水合物要到 200°C 才會失水，普通室溫乾燥根本無效。
blocks.en: Method 1 (calcium chloride, CaCl₂): Used for multiple-unit containers (bottles). Calcium chloride is a strong desiccant with a high moisture capacity, suited to long experiments of 14–35 days. However, it must first be dried at 215°C for 7.25 hours to ensure the hexahydrate is fully converted to the anhydrous form, because the hexahydrate does not lose its water until 200°C, so ordinary room-temperature drying is simply ineffective.

blocks.zh: Methods 2 & 3 (USP 分子篩 RS)：專為泡殼（blister）設計，成型為吻合空腔形狀的錠片。使用 USP 認證參考標準，確保不同批次、不同實驗室之間的可重現性。
blocks.en: Methods 2 & 3 (USP Molecular Sieve RS): Designed specifically for blisters, formed into tablets that match the cavity shape. Using a USP certified reference standard ensures reproducibility between different lots and different laboratories.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑就像測試包裝屏障的「感應器」。你把一個精確乾燥的感應器放進容器，關好蓋子，放進潮濕環境。一週後打開稱重——感應器吸收了多少水，就反映了有多少水蒸氣從外部滲透進來。
blocks.en: The desiccant is like a "sensor" for testing the packaging barrier. You put a precisely dried sensor into the container, close the lid, and place it in a humid environment. After a week you open it and weigh it; the amount of water the sensor has absorbed reflects how much water vapor has permeated in from outside.

blocks.zh: 這個感應器必須是「完全乾燥」的起始狀態，就像體重計要先歸零才能稱重。如果乾燥劑一開始就含有殘留水分，數據就不準了——這就是為什麼預乾燥步驟如此嚴格。
blocks.en: The sensor must start in a "completely dry" state, just as a scale must be zeroed before weighing. If the desiccant already contains residual moisture at the start, the data will be inaccurate, which is why the pre-drying step is so strict.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: 五個穩態數據點的意義：第 0–7 天是「平衡期」，不計入計算。第 7、14、21、28、35 天的五個稱重點用於線性回歸，斜率即為 MVTR。
blocks.en: Significance of the five steady-state data points: Days 0–7 are the "equilibration period" and are not included in the calculation. The five weighing points on days 7, 14, 21, 28 and 35 are used for the linear regression, and the slope is the MVTR.

blocks.zh: 為什麼要等到穩態？因為初期水蒸氣擴散速率會受到溫度平衡、包裝材料吸附等影響而不穩定。只有達到穩態後，速率才是真正代表包裝屏障性能的數值。
blocks.en: Why wait for steady state? Because early on, the rate of water vapor diffusion is unstable, affected by temperature equilibration, adsorption by the packaging material and so on. Only once steady state is reached does the rate truly represent the barrier performance of the package.

blocks.zh: 30 分鐘平衡的意義：每次稱重前讓容器在稱量室的溫度/濕度條件下平衡 30 分鐘，避免溫差導致的表面冷凝水影響重量讀數。
blocks.en: Significance of the 30-minute equilibration: Before each weighing, let the containers equilibrate for 30 minutes under the temperature/humidity conditions of the weighing room, to avoid surface condensation caused by temperature differences affecting the weight reading.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 為什麼 Method 1 的 time 0 重量記錄了但「不用於計算」？如果把 time 0 也納入回歸，結果會有什麼偏差？
blocks.en: Why is the time 0 weight in Method 1 recorded but "not used in the calculation"? If time 0 were also included in the regression, what bias would the result have?

blocks.zh: Method 1 規定容器出腔後必須在 2 小時內完成稱重並放回。為什麼有這個限制？
blocks.en: Method 1 requires that containers be weighed and returned to the chamber within 2 hours of removal. Why is this limit in place?

blocks.zh: Table 2 — Torque for Screw-Type Closures 旋蓋扭矩規格表
blocks.en: Table 2 — Torque for Screw-Type Closures

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 扭矩規格的意義
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Significance of the Torque Specification

blocks.zh: Torque (扭矩/旋緊力矩)：旋緊瓶蓋時施加的力矩，單位 inch-pounds（英制）或 Newton-meters（公制）。扭矩直接影響瓶蓋的密封程度——扭矩太低，密封不完全；扭矩太高，可能損壞蓋子或瓶口。
blocks.en: Torque (tightening torque): The torque applied when tightening a bottle cap, in inch-pounds (imperial) or Newton-meters (metric). Torque directly affects how well the closure seals: too little torque gives an incomplete seal, while too much may damage the cap or the bottle finish.

blocks.zh: Table 2 規定的是「建議的手動扭矩範圍」，目的是確保測試條件標準化：所有實驗室測試同一容器時，用相同的扭矩範圍，結果才具可比性。
blocks.en: Table 2 specifies the "recommended manual torque range" so that the test conditions are standardized: when all laboratories test the same container using the same torque range, the results are comparable.

blocks.zh: 對於中間尺寸的瓶蓋，使用「下一個較大直徑」的扭矩——這是一個保守的設計，確保邊界情況不會因扭矩不足而低估 MVTR。
blocks.en: For intermediate closure sizes, use the torque for the "next larger diameter". This is a conservative design that ensures borderline cases do not underestimate MVTR because of insufficient torque.

blocks.zh: 想像你在測試不同品牌的保溫瓶蓋。如果你測試 A 品牌時用力擰緊（高扭矩），測試 B 品牌時隨便旋（低扭矩），結果 A 的防水效果更好——但這不是因為 A 的材質更好，而是因為你旋緊方式不同。
blocks.en: Imagine testing the caps of thermos flasks from different brands. If you tighten brand A hard (high torque) but screw on brand B casually (low torque), brand A will appear to seal better, but not because its material is better; it is because you tightened them differently.

blocks.zh: Table 2 就是為了解決這個問題：給定一個標準化的「旋緊力道」，確保測試結果反映的是容器本身的屏障性能，而不是操作者的力道差異。
blocks.en: Table 2 exists to solve this problem: by giving a standardized "tightening force", it ensures the test result reflects the barrier performance of the container itself rather than differences in operator force.

blocks.zh: CDMO 實務含義：如果你的客戶送來樣品要做 MVTR 測試，必須確認容器規格（蓋口直徑），查 Table 2 確定扭矩範圍，並使用已校正的扭矩測試儀（如 SecurePak MRA 型彈簧扭矩測試儀）來確認操作者施力在規定範圍內。這是測試方法學驗證的一部分。
blocks.en: CDMO practical implications: If a client sends samples for MVTR testing, you must confirm the container specification (closure diameter), look up Table 2 to determine the torque range, and use a calibrated torque tester (for example, a SecurePak MRA spring torque tester) to confirm that the force applied by the operator falls within the specified range. This is part of test method validation.

blocks.zh: 一個容器的蓋口直徑是 35 mm，不在 Table 2 的列表中，應使用哪個扭矩範圍？
blocks.en: A container has a closure diameter of 35 mm, which is not listed in Table 2. Which torque range should be used?

blocks.zh: 如果在 MVTR 測試中，操作者不使用扭矩儀而是「用感覺旋緊」，可能對測試結果產生什麼影響？如何在 SOP 中控制這個風險？
blocks.en: If, in an MVTR test, the operator does not use a torque tester but tightens "by feel", what effect might this have on the test results? How can this risk be controlled in the SOP?

blocks.zh: Methods 2 & 3 — Blister Procedures 泡殼容器測試程序
blocks.en: Methods 2 & 3 — Blister Procedures

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — Method 2 vs Method 3 的設計差異
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Design Differences Between Method 2 and Method 3

blocks.zh: 兩個方法的核心差異在於「乾燥劑被飽和的速度」：
blocks.en: The core difference between the two methods lies in "how quickly the desiccant becomes saturated":

blocks.zh: 高/超高屏障 → Method 2（35 天）：水蒸氣很難進入，乾燥劑很慢才會飽和，可以進行 35 天的多點稱重，用回歸分析取得精確斜率
blocks.en: High/ultra-high barrier → Method 2 (35 days): Water vapor has difficulty entering and the desiccant saturates very slowly, so multi-point weighing over 35 days is possible, and regression analysis yields a precise slope

blocks.zh: 低屏障 → Method 3（2 天）：水蒸氣輕易進入，乾燥劑在 2 天後就快飽和了，繼續測試的數據會出現「曲線彎折」（curvilinear profile），不能再用於線性回歸。因此只稱一次（第 2 天）即可
blocks.en: Low barrier → Method 3 (2 days): Water vapor enters easily and the desiccant is close to saturation after 2 days; data from continued testing would show a "curvilinear profile" and can no longer be used for linear regression. Therefore only one weighing (day 2) is made

blocks.zh: 超高屏障的鋁箔/鋁箔泡殼就像用特種防彈玻璃做的水缸——水（水蒸氣）幾乎無法滲入，你需要等很長時間才能累積出可測量的重量變化。
blocks.en: An ultra-high-barrier foil-foil blister is like a water tank made of special bulletproof glass: water (water vapor) barely gets in, and you have to wait a very long time to accumulate a measurable weight change.

blocks.zh: 低屏障的普通 PVC 泡殼就像用紗布做的水缸——水蒸氣快速湧入，乾燥劑很快就飽和了。你必須趕在完全飽和之前（第 2 天）完成測量，否則後面的數據會失真。
blocks.en: A low-barrier ordinary PVC blister is like a water tank made of gauze: water vapor rushes in and the desiccant saturates quickly. You must complete the measurement before it is fully saturated (day 2), otherwise later data will be distorted.

blocks.zh: 「捆綁」泡殼的注意事項：為了累積足夠的重量變化訊號，可以把多張泡殼卡捆在一起作為一個「測試單元（test unit）」。但捆綁會阻礙空氣流動，可能導致數據變異性增加——這是測試方法驗證時需要評估的參數之一。
blocks.en: Notes on "bundled" blisters: To accumulate enough weight-change signal, several blister cards can be bundled together as one "test unit". However, bundling obstructs airflow and may increase data variability; this is one of the parameters to evaluate during test method validation.

blocks.zh: 超高屏障的靈活性：對於 foil-foil 等超高屏障包裝，可以「延長稱量間隔為兩倍或三倍」（即 14 天/次）來確保每次間隔的重量增加至少達到 6 mg 的偵測閾值。
blocks.en: Flexibility for ultra-high barrier: For ultra-high-barrier packaging such as foil-foil, the weighing interval can be "extended to two or three times" (that is, once every 14 days) to ensure that the weight gain in each interval reaches at least the 6 mg detection threshold.

blocks.zh: 一個泡殼的每張卡只有 6 個空腔，Method 2 最少需要捆綁幾張卡？
blocks.en: Each card of a blister has only 6 cavities. What is the minimum number of cards that must be bundled for Method 2?

blocks.zh: Method 3 的最終 MVTR 計算公式是什麼？（重量增加 ÷ 空腔數 ÷ 2 天）這個計算和 Method 2 的回歸法有什麼根本差異？
blocks.en: What is the final MVTR calculation formula for Method 3? (weight gain ÷ number of cavities ÷ 2 days) What is the fundamental difference between this calculation and the regression approach of Method 2?

blocks.zh: Calculations — Methods 1, 2, 3 線性回歸計算方法
blocks.en: Calculations — Methods 1, 2, 3 (Linear Regression)

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 線性回歸求 MVTR
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Linear Regression to Obtain MVTR

blocks.zh:
線性回歸模型：W = I + M × T
  W = 重量（mg）
  T = 時間（天）
  M = 斜率 = MVTR（mg/day）

斜率計算：
M = Σ[(Wᵢ - W̄)(Tᵢ - T̄)] / Σ[(Tᵢ - T̄)²]

例：5個數據點（第7、14、21、28、35天）
時間點均值 T̄ = (7+14+21+28+35)/5 = 21天
重量（示例）：
  Day 7:  1002.3 mg
  Day 14: 1004.8 mg
  Day 21: 1007.2 mg
  Day 28: 1009.9 mg
  Day 35: 1012.4 mg
W̄ = (1002.3+1004.8+1007.2+1009.9+1012.4)/5 = 1007.32

M ≈ (1012.4-1002.3)/(35-7) ≈ 0.36 mg/day
→ MVTR = 0.36 mg/day/container（Method 1）

Method 2：MVTR/cavity = M / 空腔數
Method 3：MVTR/cavity = ΔW / (2天 × 空腔數)
blocks.en:
Linear regression model: W = I + M × T
  W = weight (mg)
  T = time (days)
  M = slope = MVTR (mg/day)

Slope calculation:
M = Σ[(Wᵢ - W̄)(Tᵢ - T̄)] / Σ[(Tᵢ - T̄)²]

Example: 5 data points (days 7, 14, 21, 28, 35)
Mean time point T̄ = (7+14+21+28+35)/5 = 21 days
Weights (illustrative):
  Day 7:  1002.3 mg
  Day 14: 1004.8 mg
  Day 21: 1007.2 mg
  Day 28: 1009.9 mg
  Day 35: 1012.4 mg
W̄ = (1002.3+1004.8+1007.2+1009.9+1012.4)/5 = 1007.32

M ≈ (1012.4-1002.3)/(35-7) ≈ 0.36 mg/day
→ MVTR = 0.36 mg/day/container (Method 1)

Method 2: MVTR/cavity = M / number of cavities
Method 3: MVTR/cavity = ΔW / (2 days × number of cavities)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 為什麼用斜率作為 MVTR？
blocks.en: Key Concepts — Why Use the Slope as the MVTR?

blocks.zh: 理想情況下，水蒸氣在穩態下以固定速率滲透包裝（線性關係）。回歸分析的斜率就是這個「每天滲透量」——不受起始重量或截距影響，直接反映滲透速率本身。
blocks.en: Ideally, at steady state, water vapor permeates the package at a constant rate (a linear relationship). The slope of the regression is this "daily permeation amount", unaffected by the starting weight or the intercept, and directly reflects the permeation rate itself.

blocks.zh: 使用回歸（5 個點的平均趨勢）而非單點差值，可以消除單次稱量誤差的影響，提高精確度。這是計量學的基本原則：多點取平均勝過兩點取差。
blocks.en: Using regression (the average trend of 5 points) rather than the difference between two single points removes the influence of individual weighing errors and improves precision. This is a basic principle of metrology: averaging over many points beats taking the difference between two.

blocks.zh: 報告要素：除了 MVTR 數值，還必須報告：
blocks.en: Reporting elements: In addition to the MVTR value, the following must also be reported:

blocks.zh: 標準差（反映 15 個容器或 10 個測試單元間的批內變異性）
blocks.en: The standard deviation (reflecting the within-lot variability among the 15 containers or 10 test units)

blocks.zh: 容器完整描述：材質、規格、形狀、顏色（對比較不同供應商包裝至關重要）
blocks.en: A complete description of the container: material, specification, shape, color (essential for comparing packaging from different suppliers)

blocks.zh: 這些報告要求反映了監管要求：申報 MVTR 時，必須能讓審查員重現測試條件。
blocks.en: These reporting requirements reflect regulatory expectations: when an MVTR is submitted, reviewers must be able to reproduce the test conditions.

blocks.zh: Method 2 中，若一個測試單元包含 20 個空腔，斜率（M）= 2.0 mg/day，則每個空腔的 MVTR 是多少？
blocks.en: In Method 2, if a test unit contains 20 cavities and the slope (M) = 2.0 mg/day, what is the MVTR per cavity?

blocks.zh: 若 15 個容器的 MVTR 斜率數據中，有 2 個明顯偏高（outlier），可能的原因是什麼？如何處理？
blocks.en: If 2 of the 15 containers show clearly high MVTR slope data (outliers), what are the possible causes? How should they be handled?

blocks.zh: Water Method for Packaging Systems (Method 4) 水法測試程序
blocks.en: Water Method for Packaging Systems (Method 4)

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 — 水法的反向邏輯
blocks.en: Key Concepts — The Reverse Logic of the Water Method

blocks.zh: 為什麼水法用 40°C/25% RH 而非 40°C/75% RH？
blocks.en: Why does the water method use 40°C/25% RH rather than 40°C/75% RH?

blocks.zh: 關鍵在於「水蒸氣壓差（pressure gradient）」：
blocks.en: The key is the "water vapor pressure difference (pressure gradient)":

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法：容器內有乾燥劑（≈0% RH），外部 75% RH → 壓差 ≈ 75% RH（水從外進）
blocks.en: Desiccant method: desiccant inside the container (≈0% RH), 75% RH outside → pressure difference ≈ 75% RH (water enters from outside)

blocks.zh: 水法：容器內有水（≈100% RH），外部 25% RH → 壓差 ≈ 75% RH（水從內出）
blocks.en: Water method: water inside the container (≈100% RH), 25% RH outside → pressure difference ≈ 75% RH (water leaves from inside)

blocks.zh: 兩個方法的驅動力相同！這樣水法測出的 MVTR 和乾燥劑法理論上可以互相換算。
blocks.en: The driving force of the two methods is the same! This is why the MVTR measured by the water method can, in theory, be converted to and from the desiccant method.

blocks.zh: 公式與計算 — 最低用水量計算
blocks.en: Formula and Calculation — Minimum Water Quantity

blocks.zh:
水法最低用水量公式：
最低用水量 = MVTR × 總測試天數 + 建立100%RH所需水量

PVC 泡殼示例：
  MVTR = 1.5 mg/day/cavity
  測試天數 = 35 天
  建立飽和水蒸氣 = 0.025 mg（0.5 mL容積中）

最低用水量 = 1.5 × 35 + 0.025 = 52.5 mg/cavity

建議用水量 = 52.5 × 2 到 3 倍
           = 100–150 mg/cavity（約2–3滴）

注意：過量是為了確保測試結束時空腔中
仍有液態水，維持 ~100% RH 的驅動條件。
blocks.en:
Minimum water quantity formula for the water method:
Minimum water = MVTR × total test days + water needed to establish 100% RH

PVC blister example:
  MVTR = 1.5 mg/day/cavity
  Test days = 35 days
  Establishing saturated vapor = 0.025 mg (in a 0.5 mL volume)

Minimum water = 1.5 × 35 + 0.025 = 52.5 mg/cavity

Recommended water = 52.5 × 2 to 3 times
                  = 100–150 mg/cavity (about 2–3 drops)

Note: the excess ensures that liquid water
is still present in the cavity at the end of the test,
maintaining the ~100% RH driving condition.

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法就像「在乾燥的房間裡放一塊濕海綿，觀察它吸了多少水」——海綿代表乾燥劑，水從外部環境進入。
blocks.en: The desiccant method is like "placing a damp sponge in a dry room and observing how much water it absorbs": the sponge represents the desiccant, and water enters from the external environment.

blocks.zh: 水法就像「在潮濕的房間裡放一杯水，觀察它蒸發了多少」——水從容器內部蒸發到乾燥的外部環境。
blocks.en: The water method is like "placing a glass of water in a humid room and observing how much of it evaporates": water evaporates from inside the container into the dry external environment.

blocks.zh: 兩者測量的是同一個「牆壁（包裝壁）的通透性」，只是觀察的方向相反。
blocks.en: Both measure the same "permeability of the wall (the package wall)"; only the direction of observation is opposite.

blocks.zh: 冷成型鋁箔泡殼的特殊注意：Cold-form foil（鋁/塑膠複合冷成型）的泡殼是不透明的，無法用肉眼觀察是否還有水。必須在測試結束後打開每個空腔確認，確保「水在測試期間始終存在」這一前提成立。如果水在測試中途蒸發完了，後半段數據就無效。
blocks.en: Special note for cold-form foil blisters: Cold-form foil (aluminum/plastic laminate, cold-formed) blisters are opaque, so you cannot see by eye whether water remains. Each cavity must be opened and checked after the test to confirm that the premise "water was present throughout the test" holds. If the water evaporates completely partway through the test, the data from the second half are invalid.

blocks.zh: 斜率為負值：水法的重量是隨時間「減少」的（水在蒸發），所以回歸斜率為負數。取絕對值後才是 MVTR。這是和乾燥劑法（斜率為正）的計算上唯一差異。
blocks.en: Negative slope: In the water method the weight "decreases" over time (the water evaporates), so the regression slope is negative. The MVTR is its absolute value. This is the only calculation difference from the desiccant method (positive slope).

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 在 CDMO 環境中，客戶可能要求驗證他們的新型鋁塑複合泡殼包裝。你可以選擇乾燥劑法（Method 2）或水法（Method 4）。水法的優勢在於：
blocks.en: In a CDMO setting, a client may ask you to verify their new aluminum-plastic laminate blister package. You can choose either the desiccant method (Method 2) or the water method (Method 4). The advantages of the water method are:

blocks.zh: 不需要預乾燥 USP 分子篩乾燥劑（省去一個 250°C 烘乾步驟）
blocks.en: No need to pre-dry the USP Molecular Sieve desiccant (saving a 250°C drying step)

blocks.zh: 直接加蒸餾水，操作相對簡便
blocks.en: Distilled water is added directly, so the operation is relatively simple

blocks.zh: 但需要額外的濕度控制手套箱設備（25% RH 控制）
blocks.en: However, it requires additional humidity-controlled glove box equipment (25% RH control)

blocks.zh: 選擇哪個方法，需要根據實驗室現有設備、客戶要求和 ICH 穩定性測試條件對齊需求來決定。
blocks.en: Which method to choose depends on the laboratory's existing equipment, client requirements, and the need to align with ICH stability testing conditions.

blocks.zh: 一個超高屏障的 foil-foil 泡殼，預估 MVTR 約 0.005 mg/day/cavity。使用水法時，最少需要準備多少水/空腔（測試 35 天）？
blocks.en: An ultra-high-barrier foil-foil blister has an estimated MVTR of about 0.005 mg/day/cavity. For the water method, what is the minimum amount of water per cavity that must be prepared (35-day test)?

blocks.zh: 水法和乾燥劑法得到的 MVTR 理論上應相同，但實際可能略有差異。列舉可能造成差異的三個因素。
blocks.en: The MVTR obtained by the water method and the desiccant method should theoretically be the same, but in practice may differ slightly. List three factors that could cause the difference.

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: 乾燥劑法三種方法依屏障等級和容器類型選用：Method 1（多單元瓶裝，35 天）、Method 2（高/超高屏障泡殼，35 天）、Method 3（低屏障泡殼，2 天）
blocks.en: The three desiccant methods are selected by barrier grade and container type: Method 1 (multiple-unit bottles, 35 days), Method 2 (high/ultra-high-barrier blisters, 35 days), Method 3 (low-barrier blisters, 2 days)

blocks.zh: Table 2 旋蓋扭矩規格確保多單元容器測試的標準化，應使用已校正的扭矩測試儀執行
blocks.en: The Table 2 closure torque specification ensures standardized testing of multiple-unit containers, and a calibrated torque tester should be used

blocks.zh: MVTR 由線性回歸斜率計算：斜率 = 每天重量增加（mg/day），Method 2 需除以空腔數
blocks.en: MVTR is calculated from the slope of the linear regression: slope = weight gain per day (mg/day); for Method 2 it must be divided by the number of cavities

blocks.zh: 水法（Method 4）使用反向條件（40°C/25% RH），測量重量「減少」，取絕對值斜率即為 MVTR；壓力差與乾燥劑法等效
blocks.en: The water method (Method 4) uses reverse conditions (40°C/25% RH) and measures weight "loss"; the absolute value of the slope is the MVTR; the pressure difference is equivalent to that of the desiccant method

blocks.zh: 超高屏障包裝需增加空腔數（最多 30 個）或延長稱量間隔，確保每次間隔重量變化達到 6 mg 偵測閾值
blocks.en: Ultra-high-barrier packaging requires more cavities (up to 30) or a longer weighing interval to ensure that the weight change in each interval reaches the 6 mg detection threshold
